protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. CVE-2026-43627 is PUBLISHED and describes unchecked allocation-size multiplication in llama_batch_init(). The b9058 source allocates embd with sizeof(float) * n_tokens_alloc * embd, per-token seq_id with sizeof(llama_seq_id) * n_seq_max, and the seq_id pointer array with n_tokens_alloc + 1, without parameter or overflow checks; later writes can exceed an undersized allocation.
